label: What is caused by another is not INFINITE_1, from reception limitation
meaning: Let x have its being caused by some c other than x. By the first premise x's esse is received in some principle z; by the second its esse is limited; by the third an INFINITE_1 being's esse is not limited, so x is not INFINITE_1. The step from having an external cause of esse to having received esse (kept apart in DISAMB-ESSE-RECEPTION) is the one explicit bridge premise, not an identification of the two senses, and the derivation does not pass through Creature (an earlier draft of this PR did, through STMT-CAUSED-IN-BEING-BY-ANOTHER-IS-CREATURE and STMT-CREATURE-ESSE-IS-RECEIVED; it was replaced because those two premises read Creature in different extensions, broad and DEF-CREATURE's narrow one). The scope condition of the conclusion binds the first premise in the same way (definition 80dea550). Conditional consequence; the three premises stay open (the bridge bare, the other two supported by q.7 a.1-2 readings).
